name: S2 Pro
description: Fish Audio S2 is the second-generation TTS model from Fish Audio. It's trained on over 10 million hours of audio across approximately 80 languages, and it introduces inline tag control: natural-language instructions embedded directly in your script at any position, giving you fine-grained direction over how speech is delivered at the word or phrase level.
